bounds.domain: One Android deployment in browser Google mode. Cloud offers every method, so Google's readiness depends only on Android's verification of the return link, which can complete once at any time. At most four probes, two joined callers, six local link checks, and the short (method) and long (answer) cache lifetimes each ending at any time.
bounds.assumptions: A probe measures the link's verification at the moment it answers. Email and SMS are ready throughout, so the cached answer is none, partial (Google not ready) or ready. The 30-second method TTL, the six-hour answer TTL and the watch delays are projected to events.
bounds.limitations: Cloud-side changes of a method, probe failure (which answers unknown methods), the stored cache across processes, native Google mode, several deployments and the renderer's handling of the unretained change event are outside this model. The JVM fixture runs the exact measure, status, probe, resume and link-watch methods with a closed clock and queued ports.
